description: This Java class 'RestClient' functions as a client for RESTful web services, providing methods for creating, reading, updating, deleting person records, and testing pagination through HTTP requests using Spring's RestTemplate. The class demonstrates usage of external utility classes AuthUtil and PersonDTO, and includes main method for executing CRUD operations and pagination testing.

classes.name: RestClient
classes.description: A Java class providing methods to interact with RESTful endpoints for person management, including CRUD operations and pagination testing.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point of the application, executing CRUD operations and paginated listing of persons.

methods.name: createPersonWithAssignedId
methods.description: Creates a person with a specified ID by sending a POST request to the REST API.

methods.name: getFirstPageWithTenElements
methods.description: Retrieves the first page with 10 person records via a GET request, printing the response.

methods.name: getFirstPageWithFifteenElements
methods.description: Retrieves the first page with 15 person records via a GET request, printing the response.

methods.name: createPerson
methods.description: Creates a person with fixed ID 1 by sending a POST request, using a builder for PersonDTO.

methods.name: readPerson
methods.description: Reads a person with ID 1 via a GET request to the REST API.

methods.name: updatePerson
methods.description: Updates a person with ID 1, changing first and last names via a PUT request.

methods.name: deletePerson
methods.description: Deletes a person with ID 1 via a DELETE request.
